product.name: M&S Frankincense and Myrrh Star Candle, Chrome
product.detailed_description: This scented candle is presented in an elegant star-shaped glass jar and embellished with lustrous mercury detailing. Its sweet and spicy scent combines warming myrrh and frankincense with vanilla, voilet, lavender, zesty orange and rich clove. This fragrance is part of the Amber family of fragrances. Amber scents are rich and warming and may contain notes such as vanilla, pepper, tonka bean and amber.
